# Trogon.Error v0.8.1 - Table of Contents

A library for dealing with error-related tasks

## Pages

- [Trogon.Error](https://trogon-error.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://trogon-error.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Trogon.Error.Metadata](https://trogon-error.hexdocs.pm/Trogon.Error.Metadata.md): A structured container for error metadata with support for visibility controls.
- [Trogon.Error.MetadataValue](https://trogon-error.hexdocs.pm/Trogon.Error.MetadataValue.md): Represents a metadata entry with both value and visibility level.

- Exceptions
  - [Trogon.Error](https://trogon-error.hexdocs.pm/Trogon.Error.md): [Error Specification](https://straw-hat-team.github.io/adr/adrs/0129349218/README.html) implementation for Elixir.
